svg.title: Serena · reference
svg.desc: Cumulative reference from 7 files and 7 retained file-version samples. 9 distinct symbol responses matched source bodies when collected. Each file-version sample is frozen on first collection; previously recorded responses are not counted again. Edits and deletion do not remove saved samples. Character difference divided by four: 8510 estimated tokens. Not actual savings or billing savings. New samples can change the net difference and percentage.
